_doc: Designer variantId alias → library property tuple. csv-to-spec applies at emit time. Mapping CSV authors with variantId convention (`_01/_02`) but some library ComponentSets use property-driven variants (`材质=A, 模式=B`). When mapping CSV variantId matches a key in `mappings`, the value replaces it in spec output. render-spec findVariant then matches via property syntax. Source: Improvement_doc/audit-stale-setkeys-2026-05-28.md Category B.
_migration_note: 2026-05-28: 以测试版 only 为基准迁移 (audit doc §4.9). 测试版 的 AlertDialog/DrawerWindow 为 Property=bareAlias 或 档位=bareAlias 形式 (e.g. 'Property=AlertDialog_ComponentSet_01', '档位=DrawerWindow_ComponentSet_high_01') — render-spec findVariant step 2 通过 bare alias 直接匹配. propertyMap 不需要. Scrollbar/Actionsheet/NoticeBar 测试版 未 publish → 移至 blockers.

blockers.Actionsheet_ComponentSet_01: 测试版 未 publish. 旧 OS4 UI Kit 的 类型=陈列型 映射废弃. 影响: 4 spec.
blockers.NoticeBar_ComponentSet_01: 测试版 未 publish. 旧 OS4 UI Kit 的 颜色=灰色-默认, 模式=Light 映射废弃. 影响: 72 spec.
blockers.Menu_ComponentSet_00: Library set d4c7b5f8 has 4 variants by State×Mode (Frosted/Default × Light/Dark). Designer alias _00/_01/_03 doesn't have clean property mapping. _00 likely = unrendered (per generic _00 convention). Awaiting designer decision on property tuple semantics for _01/_03.
blockers.Menu_ComponentSet_01: Same as above. Tentative: State=Frosted, Mode=Light. Confirm with designer.
blockers.Menu_ComponentSet_03: Same as above. Visual difference (grouped/submenu arrow) is content, not variant property — needs separate inner override mechanism.
blockers.SegmentedControls_ComponentSet_01: Library set d9ccd733 has 24 variants by 颜色模式 × 个数 × 背景环境. Alias _01/_02 likely encodes device (phone/Fold/Pad). Designer needs explicit mapping per device — possibly auto-derive from frame device + count.
blockers.NavigationBar_ComponentSet_Notes_03: Library set ac60af7e has only _01 and _02 variants. _03 referenced in mapping CSV but not implemented in library. Library gap — designer needs to publish variant.
blockers.FloatingWindow_ComponentSet_02: Library set d586e39f has only _01 variant. _02 (二级浮窗 with back-button NavBar_08) not implemented. Library gap.
